provenance.selection_rule: centered = ascending dataset indices with |CTE| < 1.0 (n_centered=893); sample = centered[round(linspace(0, n_centered-1, num_images))]; num_images='all' selects every centered image in order.
provenance.control: Random zero-mean orthonormal 8D basis per anchor and seed; uses the same local-PCA sigma_proj scale vector, alpha list, mean invariant, clipping, property, thresholds, and solver semantics.
